mem.19:
Andrew & Audrey, 2023:
Andrew started a substantially different job as Financial Analyst in 2023-03-20–26. Lives in city/apartment, has girlfriend. Loves animals, birds (especially eagles’ strength/grace), hiking (favorite outdoor activity), photography. Nature feels like home for his soul: peaceful reset, freedom from city/work stress. Audrey similarly finds nature grounding/restorative; dogs are family, her universe, joy and comfort through difficult times.

Dogs:
Audrey’s four: Pepper, Precious (female), Panda, Pixie. Had first three since ~2020-03; announced adopting small white puppy Pixie 2023-04-02. Pepper initially needed adjustment, then inseparable from Pixie. On 2023-07-03 said all four were three years old, two Jack Russell mixes/two Chihuahua mixes (individual breeds unspecified). Obtained dogs from nearby breeder. Loves more dogs but four enough to give each attention (2023-08-16).
Favorite resting places: Pepper couch; Pixie bed; Precious chair; Panda rug. Dogs sleep snuggled together, best friends. 2023-07-27 described oldest relaxed sage, second playful, third naughty/cuddly, youngest adventurous (names not assigned). Childhood male dog Max: energetic, fetch-loving; long neighborhood walks exploring paths, confiding hopes/worries; cherished listener.
Andrew had no pet 2023-03-27, family had dog: misses hiking together. Sought dog via websites/shelters/friends; initially wanted small dog for apartment. Introduced new puppy Toby 2023-07-11; male German Shepherd, smart/loyal (2023-08-04). Favorite spot fluffy floor blanket (2023-08-16). Wants deep bond/adventures. 2023-09-06 said Toby too young for hiking, despite earlier short-hike plan. Photos sometimes show small dog; don’t infer breed from images.

Housing/dog care:
Andrew struggled finding dog-friendly rental 2023-04 through 2023-09-06, wanted near park/woods. Audrey recommended housing websites with pet filters (unnamed); offered help 2023-06-02, requested emailed criteria. Andrew remained searching even after acquiring Toby.
Audrey moved by 2023-06-26, still unpacking, bigger backyard with agility equipment/toys. Nearby park for walks. Takes dog road trips every couple months; 2023-05-05 national park trip. Usually hour-long walks at dogs’ pace, sometimes multiple daily walks. Fetch ball/frisbee, park playdates, dogs enjoy scents/exploration; protective shoes/leash photo 2023-05-03. Dog safety top priority.
2023-05-11 enrolled June positive-reinforcement bonding class from local pet-store flyer; volunteer’s male dog friendly/playful. Rejects punishment/hurting dogs; Andrew agrees. Course challenging/time-consuming but progress by 2023-07-03. Doggy playdate 2023-06-30. Agility classes at dog park by 2023-08-04, practices twice weekly; mental/physical exercise and bonding. Grooming course 2023-08: go slowly/gently, sensitive ears/paws, patient/positive. Daily brushing, baths, nail trims. All-four vet checkup chaotic; next time individually (reported 2023-08-16).
2023-09-22 Precious pulled/broke leash at park; Audrey chased/caught her unharmed, soothed with hugs/pets, calm speech/slow walk. 2023-09-24 advice: patience, regular training, time/love, praise successes; teaches sit/stay/shake/roll over. Andrew anxious imagining losing Toby. 2023-08-24 he preferred figuring care out independently initially; bonding shouldn’t be rushed.

Trips/plans:
2023-03-27 Andrew recommended Fox Hollow views; Audrey intended to try, not yet by 2023-04-02.
2023-04-08–09 Andrew/girlfriend new city cafe: croissants, muffins, tarts; loves food outings but missed nature. Audrey baked blueberry muffins 2023-04-03–09. Proposed pastry party 2023-04-16 with her dogs; Andrew accepted, no date/place.
Audrey saw hummingbird hiking 2023-04-24–30. Andrew found nearby open hiking space by 2023-05-03, tries weekly city escapes. Recommended dog park beside park they usually walk, trees/benches; Andrew planned visit.
Andrew hiked with friends/girlfriend 2023-05-06–07; with friends 2023-06-23.
Audrey national park peak at sunset 2023-05-22–28; off-leash park fun 2023-06-01. New small wooded-trail park 2023-06-05–11; invited Andrew 2023-06-13, accepted, undated.
Andrew beginner rock-climbing class with friends 2023-06-11, reached top with encouragement, proud/hooked; interested kayaking, possibly bungee jumping.
2023-07-07 picnic with girlfriend. 2023-07-08 planned August hike with Audrey/dogs; unnamed trail photo steep ocean-view hill plus park map; Audrey to check safety/free running space. Reaffirmed 2023-07-11 including Toby; no confirmed completion.
2023-07-24 Andrew/girlfriend volunteered at shelter, extremely rewarding; Audrey never visited/volunteered as of 2023-07-27, interested.
2023-08-04 Andrew planned camping with girlfriend/Toby 2023-08-05–06; leaving for short local Toby hike. Audrey had completed stunning two-hour dog hike.
By 2023-08-16 Andrew/girlfriend visited farm for dinner vegetables.
2023-08-18 Andrew refreshing cafe work break. Planned nature reserve 2023-08-19–20, promised photos; actually reported fishing nearby lake with girlfriend that weekend, caught fish. Audrey never fished.
Andrew sunset hike 2023-09-02–03 relieved city stress. Work stressful/reduced outdoors by 2023-09-06; morning coffee/lunch walks self-care. Audrey daily self-care; recent neighbors’ dog playdate, bought cozy dog beds 2023-08-28–09-03.

Other:
Audrey arm dog/nature tattoos before 2023-04-16 (dog/sunflowers photo); another depicting four dogs by 2023-08-16. Handmade personalized engraved wooden name tags 2023-07-11; new collars/tags 2023-03-27.
Both enjoy cooking as creative stress relief. Andrew beginner by 2023-07-03, wants healthy meals. Audrey favorite family chicken pot pie evokes grandmother’s kitchen; promised recipe. Garlic go-to; Mediterranean roast chicken with garlic/lemon/herbs, easy healthy comfort favorite, promised recipe too. Likes music/wine while cooking.
Audrey mountain-lake hike with friends years earlier: relaxing chats, still water/birdsong; recalled 2023-06-26 and 2023-08-24. 2022 sunset hike ~3-hour drive from home. Photos include dogs, lakes, mountains; one favorite national-park photo shared 2023-06-02 actually depicted two horses/fence.
2023-09-24 Andrew tending flower-filled balcony. Audrey small flower/vegetable garden: Peruvian Lilies, bright delicate/easy with water/sun; photo actually cactus with two white flowers. Gardening peaceful/accomplishing; dogs explore garden. Said dogs play only with her own dogs that day, despite earlier playdates.
mem.28:
Andrew & Audrey are friends who love animals/nature and exchange photos, dog-care advice and outing plans. Andrew lives in a city with girlfriend; started Financial Analyst job 2023-03-20–26, a big change. Work/city life often stress him, limit hiking and leave him missing freedom/connection. Nature is therapeutic, a reset/home for his soul; hiking is favorite outdoor activity. Loves birds (especially eagles’ strength/grace), photography and sharing peaceful moments. Had no pets 2023-03-27; family has a dog he fondly remembers hiking with.

DOGS
Audrey: Pepper, Precious, Panda, Pixie. First three owned since ~2020-03; Pixie adopted by 2023-04-02, initially needed adjustment, then inseparable from Pepper. All four described as age 3 on 2023-07-03. Breed accounts conflict: 2023-07-03/09-24 two Jack Russell mixes + two Chihuahua mixes; 2023-10-28 Pepper/Panda Labrador mixes, Precious/Pixie Chihuahua mixes. Precious female. Pepper lounges on couch; Pixie in bed; Precious in chair; Panda on rug. Sleep cuddled together, best friends. Dogs are Audrey’s universe/family, provide unconditional love/comfort through hard times. Childhood male dog Max energetic, loved fetch; long neighborhood walks exploring/sniffing, Audrey confided hopes/worries.
Andrew searched websites/shelters/friends for dog and dog-friendly rental 2023-04–09 (still searching housing 09-06); initially thought smaller dog suited apartment, wanted park/woods nearby. Audrey suggested pet-friendly website filters, offered housing help 06-02 (email criteria). Toby introduced 07-11, male German Shepherd puppy, smart/loyal/active, loves sweaters; favorite spot fluffy floor blanket. Young age limited hikes 09-06. Buddy, male shelter puppy, adopted by 10-19; name reflects companionship/hope he and Toby become buddies. Both adjusting; Buddy loves walks/trails. By 11-22 adopted Scout; girlfriend helped choose name for adventurous spirit; got bed/toys/puppy pads, keeping leashed, planning first small nearby-park outing with Toby/Buddy. 11-04 considered third dog; Audrey advised care for existing two first. No breeds stated for Buddy/Scout.

AUDREY CARE/HOME/INTERESTS
City dogs love parks/trails, fetch/frisbee, scents, socializing; dislike snow (confused at snowy park winter 2022–23). Walks usually ~hour at their pace, sometimes multiple daily. Protective shoes shown 2023-05-03. Dog park recommended near park friends usually walk: trees/benches, unnamed. Playdates at park/neighbors (06-30, shortly before 09-06); 09-24 said only own dogs play together despite other accounts.
Signed up by 05-11 for June pet-bonding positive reinforcement workshop after local pet-store flyer; volunteer there had friendly playful male dog. Opposes punishment/hurting dogs. Course challenging/rewarding by 07-03, improving dogs but consuming trail time. Teaches sit/stay/shake/roll over. Agility at dog park by 08-04, twice weekly, good mental/physical bonding. By 11-04 joined dog owners group, aims weekly tips/play meetings.
Moved by 06-26 to bigger-backyard house; unpacking, agility equipment/toys play area. Chaotic all-four vet checkups reported 08-16; next time individually. Grooming course 08; daily brushing, regular baths/nail trims. Advice: slow/gentle/patient/positive, sensitive ears/paws. Salon 11-17: initially excited, settled/behaved, shiny coats; Andrew not yet tried groomer 11-22.
09-22 Precious broke leash chasing something at park; Audrey caught her unharmed, calmed with hugs/petting/calm voice/slow walk; photo red retractable leash black handle. Advice: patience, regular training, praise/time/love; bonding cannot rush. City dog care: time/attention, walks/exercise, daily socialization, mental stimulation (puzzles/training/hide-seek); introduce new dogs slowly, small leashed outings.
Knee injury temporarily stopped walks, resumed by 10-06. Park accident week 10-16–22 left arm in cast/one usable arm; improving 10-24. Abnormal dog behavior prompted behaviorist appointment made 10-25, attended by 10-28; questions/exam, routine changes/handling tips/positive reinforcement helping gradually.
Arm dog tattoos before 04-16 (dog/sunflowers photo); another four-dog tattoo by 08-16; additions by 10-13 (wrist flower photo), no more planned unless another dog. Handmade personality-specific tags 07-11 (engraved wooden keychains photo). New collars/tags 03-27; beds bought 08-28–09-03; toys 10-16.
Garden Peruvian Lilies + vegetable patch; relaxing/accomplishing. Usually public transport, recycles, interested cycling. Makes/sells jewelry from bottle caps/buttons/broken jewelry, donates some profits to unnamed shelter; 07-27 never volunteered, 10-06 could no longer volunteer (reason unstated). Daily self-care. Loves cooking with music/wine; garlic go-to. Family chicken pot pie recalls grandmother; Mediterranean roast chicken garlic/lemon/herbs comfort favorite; promised both recipes 07-03. Loves sushi; advised novice Andrew California/salmon rolls, sauces 10-24; ordered sushi that evening. Baked neighbor thank-you cookies by 10-13.
